content:
Alice Chen: noticed unexpected access during deploy validation — deploy-sa in ci-resources can list pods in namespace gpu-pool-prod. not intended.

Alice Chen: commands:
```
kubectl auth can-i list pods --as=system:serviceaccount:ci:deploy-sa -n gpu-pool-prod
# returns: yes
kubectl get pods -n gpu-pool-prod --as=system:serviceaccount:ci:deploy-sa
```
Alice Chen: attaching logs and audit snippets below.

Marco Diaz: :eyes: that's bad — do we have a ClusterRoleBinding granting view/cluster-admin?

Priya Patel: Deploy flow binds "ci:deploy-sa" to "system:aggregate-to-view" via ci-cluster-binding last month. maybe accidental broad binding.

Samir Rao: can we drop cluster-scope binding and create namespaced Role for gpu-pool-prod? prefer least-priv.

audit-bot: audit.log excerpt: subject="system:serviceaccount:ci:deploy-sa" verb="list" resource="pods" namespace="gpu-pool-prod" time="2026-02-20T15:12:40Z"

Priya Patel: plan: rollback binding, create Role + RoleBinding limited to get/list/watch for specific label selectors for scheduler pods. Need migration window.

Marco Diaz: also audit KMS grants — this SA shouldn't have decrypt on GPU cache key. @sec-oncall to confirm KMS policies.

sec-oncall: Confirmed: deploy-sa is in kms-decrypters group via iam-sync. Removing will affect artifact decryption for some older jobs. we need a canary.

Samir Rao: propose phased plan:
- phase 0: create namespaced Role in gpu-pool-prod, keep cluster-binding
- phase 1: update CI jobs to use namespaced role via new SA or impersonation
- phase 2: remove cluster-binding after 48h of no failures
- rollback: reapply binding and run smoke tests

Priya Patel: sample Role YAML:
```
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: gpu-pool-reader
  namespace: gpu-pool-prod
rules:
- apiGroups: [""]
  resources: ["pods"]
  verbs: ["get","list","watch"]
```

Priya Patel: and RoleBinding:
```
kind: RoleBinding
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
metadata:
  name: bind-deploy-sa-gpu-read
  namespace: gpu-pool-prod
subjects:
- kind: ServiceAccount
  name: deploy-sa
  namespace: ci
roleRef:
  kind: Role
  name: gpu-pool-reader
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
```

Marco Diaz: include an audit policy to log requestObject.user.username and extra fields; add higher retention for gpu-pool namespace events.

audit-bot: created ticket INFSEC-4321 for KMS membership change and audit retention tweak.

Alice Chen: timeline? we should do this during low traffic window tomorrow 02:00 UTC.

Samir Rao: I'll own the rollout, Priya will handle RBAC manifests, Marco will coordinate KMS and audit changes. @deploy-bot schedule? :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: scheduled job gpu-rbac-canary at 2026-02-21T02:00:00Z. will post result in this thread.

Priya Patel: quick checklist:
- [ ] create Role & RoleBinding
- [ ] add CI job env to use impersonation
- [ ] adjust kms-decrypters group membership
- [ ] increase audit retention for gpu-pool-prod
- [ ] smoke tests

Samir Rao: noted. adding runbook link: https://internal.redwood/prod/runbooks/gpu-rbac

Alice Chen: thanks team. we'll monitor logs and revert if anything blows up. :thumbsup:
